question: All changes in the weather of the earth are caused by the _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sun**

 
 
• The sun is a big star that produces energy through the nuclear** fusion of Hydrogen**.
 
• The energy is produced by the nuclear fusion of **hydrogen into helium**.
 
• There are **seven layers **of the Sun.
 
• The innermost layer is known as the core while the outermost layer is known as** Corona**.
 
• Sun is the hottest glowing sphere of Plasma at the center of the solar system.
 
• It is made of gas and is mostly hydrogen (about 70%) and helium (about 28%).
 
• While carbon, nitrogen, and oxygen make up 1.5%, and the other 0.5% is made up of other elements like neon, iron, silicon, magnesium, and sulfur.
 
• It is one of the most important sources of energy for life on earth.
